name: Corner Connect
author: Boysle
description:
Meet Professor Pato who is a parrot that is in love with shapes and LEGOs.
In his class, you will need to create a shape by connecting its corners as precisely as possible. 
Over the courses, the shapes will get more complex and you will see crazy stuff!
If you complete the 6 courses, you will get your major degree in LEGO shapes!

This game was challenging to understand the concept and code the levels, lots of effort went into it.
I experimented with both LEGO behaviors and Unity coordinate systems.
I hope you play the game and finish it. It's a different experience where you think outside of the box.
I am looking forward to your criticism.
I hope you like it. :)
